_about: Every sentence the parent-call engine speaks from a fixed script, per call language.
Keys are the speech-language codes the engine actually uses (call_policy.LANGUAGE_CODES);
an Odia call is spoken in en-IN, so it uses the English lines.
request_to_talk: the whole greeting of every call whose reason is not positive_feedback
(founder decision, 23 Oct 2026: a concern call is a request to talk and never states the concern).
request_to_talk is the same sentence as the web app's src/locales/call-scripts/request-to-talk.json
(the Docker build context is this directory, so it is copied, and test_request_to_talk checks the copies agree).
explain_in_person: what the engine says when the parent asks why, or guesses a reason.
stop_acknowledgement: spoken once, right before hanging up, when the parent asks not to be called again.
review: translation confidence. Anything other than 'source' or 'confident' needs a native speaker
to read it aloud before it is trusted on a live call.

en-IN.request_to_talk: Your child's class teacher would like to speak with you this week. Is there a good time for a short call?
en-IN.explain_in_person: The class teacher would like to explain this to you in person.
en-IN.stop_acknowledgement: Of course, we will not call you again. Thank you, and goodbye.

hi-IN.request_to_talk: आपके बच्चे के क्लास टीचर इस हफ़्ते आपसे बात करना चाहते हैं। क्या कोई अच्छा समय है जब थोड़ी देर बात हो सके?
hi-IN.explain_in_person: यह बात क्लास टीचर आपको ख़ुद समझाना चाहते हैं।
hi-IN.stop_acknowledgement: जी, बिल्कुल, हम आपको दोबारा फ़ोन नहीं करेंगे। धन्यवाद, नमस्ते।

bn-IN.stop_acknowledgement: অবশ্যই, আমরা আপনাকে আর ফোন করব না। ধন্যবাদ, নমস্কার।
bn-IN.review: unsure: needs a native Bengali speaker

gu-IN.request_to_talk: તમારા બાળકના વર્ગશિક્ષક આ અઠવાડિયે તમારી સાથે વાત કરવા માંગે છે. થોડી વાર વાત કરવા માટે તમને કયો સમય અનુકૂળ રહેશે?

pa-IN.request_to_talk: ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਬੱਚੇ ਦੇ ਕਲਾਸ ਟੀਚਰ ਇਸ ਹਫ਼ਤੇ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਨਾਲ ਗੱਲ ਕਰਨਾ ਚਾਹੁੰਦੇ ਹਨ। ਥੋੜ੍ਹੀ ਦੇਰ ਗੱਲ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਲਈ ਕਿਹੜਾ ਸਮਾਂ ਠੀਕ ਰਹੇਗਾ?
pa-IN.explain_in_person: ਇਹ ਗੱਲ ਕਲਾਸ ਟੀਚਰ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਆਪ ਸਮਝਾਉਣਾ ਚਾਹੁੰਦੇ ਹਨ।
pa-IN.stop_acknowledgement: ਜੀ ਬਿਲਕੁਲ, ਅਸੀਂ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਦੁਬਾਰਾ ਫ਼ੋਨ ਨਹੀਂ ਕਰਾਂਗੇ। ਧੰਨਵਾਦ, ਸਤ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਅਕਾਲ।
pa-IN.review: unsure: needs a native Punjabi speaker

kn-IN.request_to_talk: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮಗುವಿನ ಕ್ಲಾಸ್ ಟೀಚರ್ ಈ ವಾರ ನಿಮ್ಮೊಂದಿಗೆ ಮಾತನಾಡಲು ಬಯಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಹೊತ್ತು ಮಾತನಾಡಲು ನಿಮಗೆ ಯಾವ ಸಮಯ ಅನುಕೂಲವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ?
kn-IN.explain_in_person: ಅದನ್ನು ಕ್ಲಾಸ್ ಟೀಚರ್ ಅವರೇ ನಿಮಗೆ ಖುದ್ದಾಗಿ ತಿಳಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
kn-IN.stop_acknowledgement: ಖಂಡಿತ, ನಾವು ನಿಮಗೆ ಮತ್ತೆ ಕರೆ ಮಾಡುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಧನ್ಯವಾದಗಳು, ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ.
kn-IN.review: unsure: needs a native Kannada speaker

ta-IN.request_to_talk: உங்கள் குழந்தையின் வகுப்பு ஆசிரியர் இந்த வாரம் உங்களுடன் பேச விரும்புகிறார். சிறிது நேரம் பேச உங்களுக்கு எந்த நேரம் வசதியாக இருக்கும்?
ta-IN.explain_in_person: அதை வகுப்பு ஆசிரியரே உங்களிடம் நேரடியாக விளக்குவார்.
ta-IN.stop_acknowledgement: கண்டிப்பாக, நாங்கள் இனி உங்களை அழைக்க மாட்டோம். நன்றி, வணக்கம்.
ta-IN.review: unsure: needs a native Tamil speaker (written register may sound formal on a call)

te-IN.request_to_talk: మీ పిల్లల క్లాస్ టీచర్ ఈ వారం మీతో మాట్లాడాలనుకుంటున్నారు. కొద్దిసేపు మాట్లాడటానికి మీకు ఏ సమయం వీలుగా ఉంటుంది?

te-IN.stop_acknowledgement: తప్పకుండా, మేము మీకు మళ్ళీ ఫోన్ చేయము. ధన్యవాదాలు, నమస్కారం.
te-IN.review: unsure: needs a native Telugu speaker
